LanguageData.PBG.Tut.P1.Title: 1. Punching bag
LanguageData.PBG.Tut.P1.Body:
There is no opponent here. There is a rhythm.
The bag swings twice to call the beat - swing, swing - and you answer with your fist on the beats that follow. One answer, two, or a quick flurry of four.
Punching faster is not the game. Punching on time is.
LanguageData.PBG.Tut.P2.Title: 2. The beat
LanguageData.PBG.Tut.P2.Body:
The tape at the bottom is the score sheet. Dots slide in from the right; the moment one touches the line, punch - click, or press Enter.
Faint ticks are the bag's calls. You do not punch those. The big gold dot at the end is the finisher.
The set starts with your first press, after a two-beat count-in. Higher tiers raise the tempo and thicken the flurries; the timing windows never change.
LanguageData.PBG.Tut.P3.Title: 3. Scoring
LanguageData.PBG.Tut.P3.Body:
Every answer is judged by how close to the beat it landed.
Swinging at nothing costs no points, but it breaks your combo and your dignity. Miss a note entirely and it is gone - the beat does not wait.
Reach the target score and the set is cleared. Records keep your best score, your best combo, and your clean hits.
